tools.name: get_takeoff_status
tools.description: Read an owned project and its latest asynchronous takeoff progress, completion limitations and review link. Never advances or restarts a run, uses credits or changes billing. Poll this tool after run_takeoff returns a running result.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Use first after connecting to confirm which Portravo account you are acting on: returns the account id, name and email. Read-only; the remaining takeoff credits are in preflight_takeoff.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_takeoff_status, get_profile, list_projects, get_takeoff, export_reviewed_estimate · Private data: get_takeoff, attach_plan_pdf · Public sink: preflight_takeoff, get_profile, create_project · Destructive: get_takeoff_status, create_project, run_takeoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_takeoff_status, get_profile, list_projects, get_takeoff, export_reviewed_estimate · Private data: get_takeoff, attach_plan_pdf · Public sink: preflight_takeoff, get_profile, create_project · Destructive: get_takeoff_status, create_project, run_takeoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
